heading: Purposes
lead: The purposes of this chapter are—

tree.text: to improve and expand the system of safety precautions that protects the welfare of professional boxers; and
to assist State boxing commissions to provide proper oversight for the professional boxing industry in the United States.

notes.text: Effective DateSection effective Jan. 1, 1997, see section 23 of Pub. L. 104–272, set out as a note under section 6301 of this title.
